prompt:
Add a discount-code feature to the checkout: percentage and fixed-amount codes, validated server-side, with an expiry date. Update the database, wire the checkout UI, and keep the tests green.

(This is a SAMPLE session shipped with Agent Review Studio so you can try every part of the review before your own agents show up. Archive it when you are done — it runs in a sandbox repository and never touches your own projects.)
outcome: Implemented discount codes end-to-end: new discounts table, validation service and checkout integration. One test was updated to match the new totals API. Note: I refactored src/checkout/discount.ts again after the last test run to simplify rounding — re-run the suite before merging.
plan: Add a discounts table with code, type, value and expiry
Create a validation service with server-side expiry checks
Wire the discount field into the checkout flow
Update the checkout tests for the new totals

timeline.title: Declared the 4-step plan
timeline.detail: Schema first, then the service, then UI wiring, tests last.

+  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
+);
+CREATE INDEX idx_discounts_code ON discounts (code);
